description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 55 (Details of Energy Centre) for the Town Centre West phase of planning permission reference 585/APP/2015/848 dated 21-12-2015 for 'Variation of condition 5 of planning permission ref: 585/APP/2009/2752 dated 18/01/2012 (redevelopment of former RAF Uxbridge site) to amend approved plans and drainage strategy regarding the Town Centre Extension phase of the development'.
decision_conditions: The submitted details are appropriate in discharging the requirements of Condition 55 in part for the 'Town Centre Extension' phase of the St Andrews Park site as approved under reserved matters application 585/APP/2016/4504. The applicant is made aware that further details are required to discharge Condition 55 in relation to all other phases of development relevant to planning application 585/APP/2015/848 other than where details pursuant to this condition have previously been discharged.
